snippet.title: Bismarck | SHIP EXPLORER | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The battleship Bismarck has entered legend as one of history's most storied warships. Now you can walk her decks and learn about how this steel beast functioned! Bring Bismarck's massive main guns to life and see them fire with an earth-shattering roar! Explore the legendary battleship and interact with objects and items to learn how they made Bismarck function as a weapon of war. Control the weather and the time to get the perfect angle with photo mode and recrate some of your favourite wartime snaps. Access rare and unusual parts of the ship's superstructure by climbing the forward control tower to see the ship from angles that haven't been seen since 1941. Rewind the clock and experience Bismarck's final moments as she is sunk after battle with the Royal Navy. This is Bismarck AS YOU'VE NEVER SEEN HER!
